subject: Discovery recap: Observability & Evals for FinPay (dashboards, golden prompts, regression alerts)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@finpay.com>, Chris Tan <chris.tan@finpay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T15:05:00-08:00
Subject: Discovery recap: Observability & Evals for FinPay (dashboards, golden prompts, regression alerts)

Hi Samantha / Chris —

Thanks for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and to capture next steps. If anything below needs correction, flag it and I’ll update.

Pain points / goals
- Observability gap: no consolidated dashboards for prompt-level performance (latency, failure mode, hallucination rates).
- Regression risk: model updates cause quality regressions that only surface in prod; no reliable pre-rollout detection.
- Tracing hooks: want to correlate API requests to downstream telemetry (request -> model version -> output metrics).
- Golden prompts / evals: need a repeatable golden prompt set and automated regression alerts tied to it.

Current stack (as discussed)
- Inference: in-house service fronting models on EKS (Seldon for model routing).
- Observability: Prometheus + Grafana for infra; no model-level dashboards yet.
- CI/CD: releases via GitHub Actions; manual canary checks today.

Success criteria for POC
1) Delivery of a Redwood dashboard showing prompt-level metrics and a small set of golden prompts (example set of ~25 prompts).
2) Tracing hooks enabled for end-to-end request lineage into your existing tracing/observability.
3) Automated regression alerts (email/Slack) when golden-prompt performance drops beyond threshold.
4) Compact POC that demonstrates rollout guardrails (canary + automatic rollback).

What we’ll deliver next
- POC plan and timeline (attached: poc-plan-finpay.pdf).
- Dashboard mockups (attached: dash-mockups.png).
- Short evals overview showing how we run golden-prompt regression checks.

Questions / asks from FinPay (please confirm):
- Who will be the primary engineering contact for tracing/instrumentation?
- Any SOC 2 or compliance constraints we should prep for (we can share security docs).
- Can you confirm a target success metric (e.g., maximum allowed delta on "helpfulness" score during POC)?

Proposed next steps
- We’ll scope a 2–3 week POC starting week of March 8.
- Schedule a 30-min kickoff to align owners & instrumentation plan.
- Share security/compliance packet and a stub SOW for legal if needed.

Attachments: poc-plan-finpay.pdf (POC plan), dash-mockups.png (dashboard mockups)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendly link for the kickoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Observability & Evals for FinPay (dashboards, golden prompts, regression alerts)

Thanks Marissa — this looks right. A few clarifications from our side:

- Stack: confirmed — EKS with Seldon for model routing; we use an internal prompt-store service (no public product) and host embeddings in-house.
- Tracing: we use Jaeger; ideally we want Redwood to emit trace ids or have a small integration so we can stitch model requests into our traces.
- Compliance: we are SOC 2 Type II in progress; please send your security pack.
- Success metric: for POC we want to detect >5% drop in our aggregated "accuracy/helpfulness" metric on the golden set (we can share a baseline).

POC timing: week of March 8 works for us for a kickoff. Can you confirm expected Redwood owners and estimated infra changes (if any)?

Thanks — I’ve looped in Chris (ops) for instrumentation details.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of ML Ops, FinPay
samantha@finpay.com

Looping in quick internal notes for the POC owners and timeline:

- Owner (Redwood): Rishi Malhotra (solutions/infra) — will own tracing integration and can coordinate with your Jaeger team.
- Owner (Sales/CS): Marissa Cole — program lead and commercial contact.
- Engineering support: Lauren Bishop — will provide the dashboard templates and eval harness.

POC scope (high level)
1) Instrumentation: small SDK + trace-id propagation for request lineage.
2) Dashboard: prompt-level metrics + model-version view + alerts.
3) Evals: run golden prompt set (25 prompts) daily during POC and surface regression alerts.

Deliverables & timeline
- March 8: kickoff and instrumentation plan.
- March 9–15: initial dashboard + trace integration in a staging env.
- March 16–21: run evals against golden set and configure alert thresholds.

Attachments: poc-scope.docx (internal scope)

Notes: please confirm the FinPay primary contact for instrumentation (Samantha indicated Chris as ops). Also request any compliance addenda early so we can route to security.
